tagline: A master-planned residential community on Istanbul's far European side — wide streets, lakes, green parks, and a quieter suburban pace that feels unlike the rest of the city.

items.name: Göl Kenarı Kafeler
items.description: Café terraces overlooking the Bahçeşehir lakes — the social centre of the neighbourhood on weekend mornings.

items.name: AVM Kafeler (Bahçeşehir)
items.description: Several shopping centres in Bahçeşehir host branches of popular Turkish café chains — convenient and reliably good.

items.name: Bahçeşehir Gölleri
items.description: A series of artificial lakes with promenades, cycling paths, and picnic areas. The centrepiece of the neighbourhood and excellent for morning walks.

items.name: Tema Park
items.description: A large natural park adjacent to Bahçeşehir used for weekend family outings, cycling, and nature walks.

items.name: Göl Kenarı Restoranları
items.description: A strip of restaurants along the lakefront serving Turkish and international cuisine. Lively on weekend evenings.

tips: Bahçeşehir is car-friendly by design — having your own transport makes life much easier here.
The M3 metro line connects Bahçeşehir to the city centre but it takes 40+ minutes.
Great option for families — spacious, safe, and green in a way central Istanbul isn't.
The lake area is beautiful in autumn when the surrounding trees change colour.
